flake_dir.label: Flake directory
flake_dir.description: Select the directory containing flake.nix. Required for input updates, which modify this directory's flake.lock.

nixos_configuration.label: NixOS configuration name
nixos_configuration.description: Optional nixosConfigurations attribute to monitor, such as vm or workstation. Leave empty to disable switch-availability checks.

use_themed_logos.label: Use themed NixOS logos
use_themed_logos.description: Use rendered SVGs from the optional bundled templates (see README). Falls back to the snowflake glyph when a logo file is missing.
